609.title: SCARA: Structure and Applications
609.notes: SCARA expands Selective Compliance Assembly Robot Arm; relatively rigid Z and compliant XY for insertion. Four DOF: two vertical-axis planar revolutes, vertical prismatic joint, wrist revolute. Slide claims cycles below 0.4 s and repeatability ±0.01 mm as examples, not universal specifications. Lists vision, force-torque sensing and neural IK as AI-readiness features, not mandatory components. Applications PCB assembly, drug dispensing, solar-cell handling, bottle capping, screwdriving. Diagram shows base/frame0, d1 upward height, links l1/l2, vertical z0/z1/z2/z3 arrows up, d3 dimension arrow down from arm to wrist, coincident O3/O4 wrist frames, θ1/θ2/θ4. Potential d3-axis convention must be reconciled with later DH table rather than silently changed.
